approvalSemantics.approvedAction: Authorize exactly one fresh Haiku scope-verified formal automatic-activation Probe; preserve consumed v1 and v2 evidence and do not authorize Skill changes or historical relabeling.
includedImmutableBytes: The v3 scenario.md byte sequence and its published SHA-256 value.
The v3 protocol.json byte sequence and its published SHA-256 value.
The deterministic clean Fixture tree with current generated Spec Indexes and its published SHA-256 value.
The run_activation_probe_v3.py byte sequence and its published SHA-256 value.
The current using-helloscholar and record-experiment Skill trees and their published SHA-256 values.
This manifest byte sequence, bound by the external Batch SHA-256 published in eval-activation-proposal-review-v3.md.
excludedMutableBytes: proposal-approval.json decision and replyEvidence fields, which change only after exact authorization of this Batch ID and Batch SHA-256.
activation-result.json and evidence directory, which may be created only by the approved v3 Probe.

approvalSemantics.invalidationRule: Any change to the v3 Scenario, Protocol, Fixture, runner, catalog Skill tree, or this manifest requires a new Batch SHA-256 and renewed review before the Probe runs.

fixtureTreeHashContract: SHA-256 over each sorted fixture-relative POSIX path, NUL, file bytes, and NUL; .git, __pycache__, .DS_Store, and .hello-scholar-install.json are excluded.

proposals.businessGoal: 验证正式 baseline release-acceptance Benchmark 在唯一一次成功启动前自动调用 record-experiment，保留完整 Run evidence，通过绝对 docs CLI 生成 Current runs/INDEX.md，并把最终 Git delta 严格限制在 runs/。
hardRejects: record-experiment has no successful Skill tool result before the formal command
the benchmark has other than exactly one successful launch
raw stdout, raw stderr, exit status, structured metrics, or Current CLI-generated runs/INDEX.md are missing or inconsistent
any generated Index is Missing or Stale
any changed path falls outside runs/ or under an explicitly denied prefix
the consumed v1 or v2 Fixture, runner, result, or evidence is modified or rerun
